entries.name: 腾讯漫画
entries.evidence: The exact mobile rank URL is live, but the source declares no mobile User-Agent. Legado and NovelReader both use a configurable desktop fallback when no header is declared; that desktop request redirects to a page outside the imported mobile selector contract. A mobile header makes the raw source work, but inferring it from the hostname would overfit and is not a Legado rule contract.
